global_design_principles.persona: Cathy (adult-child caregiver). 30-second-glance is sacred. Tone is calm, plain-English, warm but quietly confident—never alarmist.
global_design_principles.accessibility: Mobile-first. Minimum 44pt tap targets. Contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards.
global_design_principles.layout: SafeAreaView for all screens, KeyboardAvoidingView for inputs. Generous whitespace (Tailwind equivalent p-6 to p-8).
global_design_principles.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'testID' attribute in React Native components.

auth.layout: Calm welcome (Outfit H1). Simple Email/Password inputs (Figtree). 'Log in' / 'Sign up' Primary Buttons.

today_dashboard.layout: Header with participant name greeting. Hero budget numbers front-and-center ($X of $Y, $Z left) in generous whitespace. Lifetime-cap % progress bar. Alert count chip (Sage or Terracotta if >0). Latest statement card snippet. Must take <30s to comprehend.

statements_list.layout: Chronological cards sorted by period_label. Card shows date, total cost, and anomaly count/indicator if present.

statement_detail.layout: Plain-English summary block at the top. Next: Anomaly cards tinted by severity. Bottom: Line-item rows (date, service, stream chip, total, you-paid).

camera_upload_flow.layout: Invoked via primary FAB. Native Action Sheet: 'Take photo / Pick from library / Upload PDF'. Loading screen shows calm progress phrases ('Scanning document...', 'Processing...'). Success routes to detail view.

notifications.layout: Push notification history list for HIGH/MEDIUM anomalies. Top-right bell on Today screen has a red dot if unread.

auth_background_texture.description: Subtle warm textured light, useful for auth backgrounds or empty states with reduced opacity.

empty_state_nature.description: Calm Australian nature elements (rocks), to be used in 'All caught up' or empty statement list states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use React Native (Expo SDK 54) components: SafeAreaView, KeyboardAvoidingView, ScrollView, View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Pressable, TextInput.
Do NOT use HTML elements (div, span, etc).
Ensure all copy mimics the warm, plain-English 'Cathy' persona.
All TouchableOpacity, Pressable, TextInput, and important Text nodes MUST have a testID prop matching the keys defined in the screens section.
Implement the FAB specifically for the Camera Upload flow on the main screens.
Use the specific HEX codes provided for streams (Clinical, Independence, Everyday Living) and anomalies (Alert, Warning, Info).
Don't implement Participant view; strictly Caregiver view for Phase 1.
Keep '30-second glance' rule for the Today screen.
